response.sql: WITH channel_executions AS (SELECT o.orderbase, oe.fillcount FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault) SELECT orderbase AS channel, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM channel_executions) AS execution_fraction FROM channel_executions GROUP BY orderbase
